candidates.label: Fasting (sawm): prescribed for taqwa with exemptions, timing, and fidya provisions
candidates.definition: In 2:183: O you who believe, fasting is prescribed upon you as upon those before you so you may attain taqwa. In 2:184-185: numbered days; exemptions for sick and travelers with make-up; fidya for those with hardship; Ramadan as month of Quran revelation; Allah intends ease. In 2:187: timing from dawn white thread to nightfall; itikaf restrictions.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
evidence.rationale: Establishes fasting obligation with taqwa as explicit purpose.

evidence.excerpt: أَيَّامٗا مَّعۡدُودَٰتٖۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٖ فَعِدَّةٞ مِّنۡ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَۚ وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُۥ فِدۡيَةٞ طَعَامُ مِسۡكِينٖۖ فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيۡرٗا فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَن تَصُومُواْ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Details exemptions (illness, travel) and fidya alternative.

evidence.excerpt: شَهۡرُ رَمَضَانَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ فِيهِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ هُدٗى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَٱلۡفُرۡقَانِۚ فَمَن شَهِدَ مِنكُمُ ٱلشَّهۡرَ فَلۡيَصُمۡهُۖ وَمَن كَانَ مَرِيضًا أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٖ فَعِدَّةٞ مِّنۡ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَۗ يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمُ ٱلۡيُسۡرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ ٱلۡعُسۡرَ وَلِتُكۡمِلُواْ ٱلۡعِدَّةَ وَلِتُكَبِّرُواْ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمۡ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Identifies Ramadan as Quran-revelation month; declares divine intent of ease.

evidence.excerpt: أُحِلَّ لَكُمۡ لَيۡلَةَ ٱلصِّيَامِ ٱلرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَآئِكُمۡۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٞ لَّكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لِبَاسٞ لَّهُنَّۗ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَخۡتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَعَفَا عَنكُمۡۖ فَٱلۡـَٰٔنَ بَٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۚ وَكُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡخَيۡطُ ٱلۡأَبۡيَضُ مِنَ ٱلۡخَيۡطِ ٱلۡأَسۡوَدِ مِنَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّواْ ٱلصِّيَامَ إِلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۚ وَلَا تُبَٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمۡ عَٰكِفُونَ فِي ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدِۗ تِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَقۡرَبُوهَاۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
evidence.rationale: Defines precise fasting window and itikaf boundaries.

candidates.urduLabel: روزہ: تقویٰ کے لیے فرض با رخصتیں، اوقات اور فدیہ
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no existing 'sawm-fasting' topic in catalog. Core ibadah legislation with built-in mercy mechanisms.

candidates.label: Divine nearness: Allah responds to the caller who asks about Him
candidates.definition: In 2:186: When My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me that they may be rightly guided.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعۡوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِي وَلۡيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِي لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡشُدُونَ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse establishes divine proximity and conditional reciprocity of supplication.

candidates.urduLabel: اللہ کی قربت: پکارنے والے کی دعا قبول
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: unique first-person divine self-disclosure embedded in legal context. Bridges du'a theology with obedience requirement.

candidates.label: Warfare ethics: proportional engagement, cessation conditions, and fitnah as graver than killing
candidates.definition: In 2:190: Fight in Allah's way those who fight you but do not transgress; Allah does not love transgressors. In 2:191-193: kill where found; fitnah worse than killing; fight until no fitnah and religion is for Allah; if they cease no hostility except against oppressors. In 2:194: sacred month reciprocity; proportional retaliation.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَٰتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡتَدُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ
evidence.rationale: Establishes defensive framing and transgression prohibition.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱقۡتُلُوهُمۡ حَيۡثُ ثَقِفۡتُمُوهُمۡ وَأَخۡرِجُوهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ أَخۡرَجُوكُمۡۚ وَٱلۡفِتۡنَةُ أَشَدُّ مِنَ ٱلۡقَتۡلِۚ وَلَا تُقَٰتِلُوهُمۡ عِندَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ حَتَّىٰ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ فِيهِۖ فَإِن قَٰتَلُوكُمۡ فَٱقۡتُلُوهُمۡۗ كَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Declares fitnah as worse than killing; permits reciprocal combat.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوۡاْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Cessation condition tied to divine forgiveness and mercy.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَٰتِلُوهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتۡنَةٞ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ لِلَّهِۖ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوۡاْ فَلَا عُدۡوَٰنَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Defines war's end-state: elimination of fitnah and religious freedom.

candidates.urduLabel: جنگ کی اخلاقیات: متناسب لڑائی، مفاتی کی شرائط، فتنہ قتل سے بڑھ کر
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no 'warfare-ethics' topic exists. Foundational just-war framework with built-in de-escalation.

candidates.label: Unjust wealth consumption: prohibition of batil acquisition and bribery of authorities
candidates.definition: In 2:188: Do not consume one another's wealth unjustly (bil-batil) nor offer it as bribery to authorities so that you may knowingly devour a portion of people's wealth in sin.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَأۡكُلُوٓاْ أَمۡوَٰلَكُم بَيۡنَكُم بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَتُدۡلُواْ بِهَآ إِلَى ٱلۡحُكَّامِ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ فَرِيقٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse prohibits both private unjust acquisition and systemic corruption through bribery.

candidates.urduLabel: ناجائز مالی منافع: باطل سے مال کھانا اور حکام کو رشوت
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no 'wealth-property' or 'criminal-law' topic covers this specific anti-corruption pairing. Bridges personal and institutional ethics.

candidates.label: Ihsan: doing good/excellence as quality beloved to Allah
candidates.definition: In 2:195: Spend in Allah's way; do not throw yourselves into destruction; and do good — indeed Allah loves the doers of good (al-muhsinin).

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تُلۡقُواْ بِأَيۡدِيكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلتَّهۡلُكَةِ وَأَحۡسِنُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Links charitable spending, self-preservation, and excellence under divine love.

candidates.urduLabel: احسان: خوبی اور خدمت اللہ کو پیاری
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: ihsan as divine-love criterion. Connects economic ethics with spiritual excellence.

candidates.label: Hajj and Umrah: completion, prevention protocols, tamattu', and post-rite remembrance
candidates.definition: In 2:196: Complete hajj and umrah for Allah; prevention requires offering; tamattu'/qiran compensation via sacrifice or fasting. In 2:197-199: taqwa as best provision; no blame seeking bounty; remember Allah at Mash'ar al-Haram acknowledging prior misguidance; hasten from Arafat with istighfar. In 2:200-203: post-rite dhikr exceeding ancestral remembrance.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَتِمُّواْ ٱلۡحَجَّ وَٱلۡعُمۡرَةَ لِلَّهِۚ فَإِنۡ أُحۡصِرۡتُمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَيۡسَرَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَدۡيِۖ وَلَا تَحۡلِقُواْ رُءُوسَكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ ٱلۡهَدۡيُ مَحِلَّهُۥۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوۡ بِهِۦٓ أَذٗى مِّن رَّأۡسِهِۦ فَفِدۡيَةٞ مِّن صِيَامٍ أَوۡ صَدَقَةٍ أَوۡ نُسُكٖۚ فَإِذَآ أَمِنتُمۡ فَمَن تَمَتَّعَ بِٱلۡعُمۡرَةِ إِلَى ٱلۡحَجِّ فَمَا ٱسۡتَيۡسَرَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَدۡيِۚ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَٰثَةِ أَيَّامٖ فِي ٱلۡحَجِّ وَسَبۡعَةٍ إِذَا رَجَعۡتُمۡۗ تِلۡكَ عَشَرَةٞ كَامِلَةٞۗ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن لَّمۡ يَكُنۡ أَهۡلُهُۥ حَاضِرِي ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
evidence.rationale: Core hajj legislation with completion command and compensation alternatives.

evidence.excerpt: لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَبۡتَغُواْ فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡۚ فَإِذَآ أَفَضۡتُم مِّنۡ عَرَفَٰتٖ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ عِندَ ٱلۡمَشۡعَرِ ٱلۡحَرَامِۖ وَٱذۡكُرُوهُ كَمَا هَدَىٰكُمۡ وَإِن كُنتُم مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
evidence.rationale: Acknowledges prior misguidance and divine guidance at Mash'ar.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا قَضَيۡتُم مَّنَٰسِكَكُمۡ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَذِكۡرِكُمۡ ءَابَآءَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَشَدَّ ذِكۡرٗاۗ فَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِنۡ خَلَٰقٖ
evidence.rationale: Post-rite remembrance surpassing ancestral memory.

candidates.urduLabel: حج اور عمرہ: تکمیل، رکاوٹ، تمتع، اور ذکر
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: no 'hajj-umrah-pilgrimage' topic exists. Comprehensive rite legislation with spiritual anthropology.

candidates.label: Dual-world supplication: seeking good in this life and hereafter with protection from Fire
candidates.definition: In 2:201: Among them is one who says: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Contrasted with 2:200: one who asks only for worldly gain with no hereafter share.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةٗ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse provides the canonical balanced supplication encompassing both realms.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا قَضَيۡتُم مَّنَٰسِكَكُمۡ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَذِكۡرِكُمۡ ءَابَآءَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَشَدَّ ذِكۡرٗاۗ فَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِنۡ خَلَٰقٖ
evidence.rationale: Contrasting worldly-only supplication establishes the deficiency this prayer corrects.

candidates.urduLabel: دونوں جہانوں کی دعا: دنیا اور آخرت میں بھلائی اور آگ سے حفاظت
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: most frequently recited Quranic du'a. Defines balanced aspiration vs. materialism.

candidates.label: Hypocrisy archetype: eloquent speech concealing quarrelsomeness and corruption
candidates.definition: In 2:204-206: Among people is one whose speech pleases you in worldly life and he calls Allah to witness what is in his heart, yet he is the most quarrelsome of opponents. When he turns away he strives throughout the land to cause corruption, destroying crops and livestock. Allah does not love corruption. When told to fear Allah, pride seizes him in sin; Hell is sufficient for him.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُعۡجِبُكَ قَوۡلُهُۥ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَيُشۡهِدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا فِي قَلۡبِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَلَدُّ ٱلۡخِصَامِ
evidence.rationale: Defines the type: pleasing exterior masking adversarial interior.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا تَوَلَّىٰ سَعَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيُفۡسِدَ فِيهَا وَيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡحَرۡثَ وَٱلنَّسۡلَۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡفَسَادَ
evidence.rationale: Specifies destructive behavior: agricultural and economic sabotage.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ أَخَذَتۡهُ ٱلۡعِزَّةُ بِٱلۡإِثۡمِۚ فَحَسۡبُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
evidence.rationale: Pride prevents reform; eschatological consequence declared.

candidates.urduLabel: منافقت کا نمونہ: میتھی باتیں مگر جھگڑا اور فساد
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: detailed psychological profile of hypocrisy. Environmental/economic destruction as diagnostic marker.

candidates.label: Entering peace/submission (silm) completely: total commitment to divine order
candidates.definition: In 2:208: O you who believe, enter into peace/submission (silm) completely, and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed he is to you a clear enemy.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱدۡخُلُواْ فِي ٱلسِّلۡمِ كَآفَّةٗ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse commands total entry into divine peace with shaytan-opposition as counterpoint.

candidates.urduLabel: مکمل طور پر سلم میں داخل ہونا
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: 'silm kaffah' as holistic submission concept. Paired with shaytan-footsteps prohibition echoing 2:168.

candidates.label: Human unity then disagreement: original community, prophetic arbitration, and envy-driven schism
candidates.definition: In 2:213: Mankind was one community (ummah wahidah) then they disagreed. Allah sent prophets as bearers of glad tidings and warners, and sent down with them the Book in truth to judge between people concerning their differences. Only those who were given the Scripture differed concerning it after clear proofs came to them, out of envy/transgression (baghyan) among themselves. Allah guided those who believed to the truth concerning that over which they differed. Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.

evidence.excerpt: كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ وَأَنزَلَ مَعَهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فِيمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِۚ وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفَ فِيهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ فَهَدَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ بِإِذۡنِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٍ
evidence.rationale: Complete verse provides etiology of religious disagreement: original unity, prophetic mediation, envy as corrupting factor, divine guidance as resolution.

candidates.urduLabel: انسانی اتحاد پھر اختلاف: اصلی امت، نبوت کا فیصلہ، حسد سے فرقہ بندی
candidates.notes: Gap candidate: foundational anthropological narrative explaining sectarianism. Envy (baghy) as root cause post-knowledge.
